Examined the two supplied base_text excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines ~3235-4002). The file_changes patch shows only documentation edits: the "Last updated" date (line 3), a clause added near base line 5253 (~5253-5258 head) saying a build-declared public resident assistant (ClusterPublicModels.tensorAssistant) adds its launch arguments and evidence digest to the resourcePolicySHA256 formula, and a changed block at base 5374-5376 (head 5379-5389). The supplied units cover base lines 3235-4002, which the patch does not touch, so the changed lines are outside what I could view. No source code, keys, attestation, authorization, or prefix-cache storage behavior is modified in the supplied evidence.

The unchanged base text describes cluster placement, link and share probe history in owner-only ~/.darkbloom/cluster files, served-speed records, batch-invariant tensor-parallel kernels, and Flint constraints. None of that is altered here. The threat-model areas most relevant, T-041 (prefix-cache storage), TB-007 and TB-003, are not affected by the visible text.

Remaining question for integration: the patch excerpt is truncated at the end (the 5374-5376 -> 5379-5389 change about the Qwen3.8 27B embedded assistant discovery is not visible). The resourcePolicySHA256 change to include assistant launch args and evidence digest is only described in docs; whether the corresponding code binds the digest correctly (NativePairMemberPolicy.require) is outside the supplied evidence and should be checked by whoever reviews the code changes. No finding is raised because documentation alone does not establish a security regression.
